name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: Over the past 28 days, Quality HVAC by Fibid generated 31 leads at a $41.84 CPL across $1,297.17 in spend, with the biggest movement being a 123.81% week-over-week surge in Google Business Profile actions (158 total: 21 calls, 110 directions, 27 web clicks), likely driven by increased local search visibility as paid search pulled back 33.37% in spend. Note that Windsor reports 31 leads while GHL shows 87 won opportunities out of 771 created, and these figures are unreconciled.

performance.verdict: SOW slippage is the real blocker; paid efficiency is fine but unscalable.

findings.text: 9 SOW milestones overdue, oldest since 2026-07-31: booking bot, intake owner, heating campaigns, LSA re-enable, and 5 others — all blocking scale-up gate.
CPL held near flat (-2.66% 7d) at $41.84 on $1,297 spend; efficiency is stable but 31 leads over 28 days is thin volume for a throttled $38.34/day run rate.
3-day lead signal: Oct 28-30 = 3 leads vs Oct 25-27 = 4 leads — marginal dip; spend also fell from ~$150 to ~$88 over same window, suggesting budget pullback not fatigue.
GBP surged +123.81% (158 actions, 110 directions) while paid search pulled back 33.37%; organic demand is outpacing paid investment — heating season intent not being captured.
GHL shows 771 opportunities created vs only 87 won (11.3% close rate) with 0 appointments logged — intake ownership gap likely causing pipeline leakage, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL login immediately — unblocks scale-up gate and stops 771-opp pipeline from leaking at 11.3% close rate.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and the intake seat is unconfirmed per SOW Aug milestone. GHL shows 771 opportunities created with only 87 won (11.3%) and 0 appointments — a likely symptom of an unmanned intake seat, not ad underperformance. Success check: named intake owner confirmed in GHL with active login by 2026-11-07. This must resolve before any budget increase is approved.

suggestions.text: Escalate heating campaigns and LSA re-enable (both overdue since Sept–Oct 1) — GBP shows 158 actions signaling live heating demand not captured by paid.
suggestions.monday_update: Heating campaigns (Google & Meta) and LSA re-enable were due 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-01 respectively — both remain undelivered. GBP logged 158 actions (+123.81% 7d) including 21 calls and 110 directions, confirming heating season demand is already arriving organically. Success check: both heating campaigns and LSA toggle confirmed live with spend recorded by 2026-11-07, and only after intake owner (S1) is confirmed per the scale-back-up gate in SOW.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL over next 3 days — if it holds below $45 as spend stabilizes near $30/day, efficiency baseline is confirmed before any scale decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta is the only active lead-gen channel delivering results (31 leads, $41.84 CPL over 28 days) with spend averaging $38.34/day. The 3-day lead trend (Oct 28-30: 3 leads) is slightly soft but spend also dropped to ~$29/day — not yet a fatigue signal. Re-check on 2026-11-03: if CPL stays below $45 and leads-per-day hold at 1+, this confirms efficiency is stable and informs any scale decision once the intake gate clears.
